facts.fact: Walvis Bay Municipality launched Ovakalimo (ovakalimo.org), an online platform where residents report service issues with a photo, are routed to the municipal department and can track status, per spokesperson Anita Kaihiva.
The City of Windhoek launched a mobile app that lets residents report incidents such as potholes and traffic light faults; no case numbers are given.

note: The survey's no on a feedback platform is contradicted by dated launches in evidence.csv; its no on published statistics gives no value.
